simple.meaning: קַו (qav) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a cord (as connecting), especially for measuring ; figuratively, a rule ; also a rim , a musical string or accord.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Kings 21:13. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קַו (H6957) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: קַו (qav) / H6957 is traced through 2 Kings 21:13, 2 Chronicles 4:2, Job 38:5, Psalms 19:5 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of Ahab’s house; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.
Also he made the molten sea† or, pool, or, reservoir of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.
Who determined its measures, if you know?
which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room,

I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.
But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it.
He has cast the lot for them,
The carpenter stretches out a line.
The measuring line will go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and will turn toward Goah.
Yahweh has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion.

When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits,* A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.
Therefore Yahweh says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.” ’

definitions.short: a cord (as connecting), especially for measuring ; figuratively, a rule ; also a rim , a musical string or accord
definitions.full: H6957. qav I. קַו only in לָקָו קַו Isa 28:10 (twice in verse); 28:13 (twice in verse), mimicry of Isaiah's words, perhaps senseless, see צַו p. 846. II. קַו see קוה . II. קַו noun masculine Zech 1:16 line (compare Kö ii. l. 40 Anm. 2 ); — absolute קַו Ezek 47:3 + Zech 1:16 Qr (Kt קוה ), קָ֑ו Isa 34:17 +; construct קַו 2Kin 21:13 +; — measuring- line ( ׳ק מִדָּה Jer 31:39 ): 1Kin 7:23 (Qr; Kt קוה , see below) = 2Chr 4:2 ; Ezek 47:3 ; for marking off a possession inland Isa 34:17 (figurative); especially ק עַל׳נְטָה in building, Job 38:5 (figurative of earth), Zech 1:16 ( יִנְּטֶה ; || יִבָּנֶה ), so ק ׳יְצָא Jer 31:39 (Qr; Kt קיה ); ק ׳נָטָה of designing idol Isa 44:13 ; marking off for destruction, ק עַל׳נָטָה 2Kin 21:13 ; Isa 34:11 ( קַרתֹהוּ ), ׳נ ׳ק Lam 2:8 ; so וְשַׂמְתִּ֫י לְקָ֔ו מִשְׁמָּט Isa 28:27 . — קַוָּם Psa 19:5 (AV their line. figurative of their domain) read probably קֹלָם their sound , Capp. 0l Che and now most. Isa 18:2 , 7 see קוקו -below; 28:10 , 13 see I. קַו . קוה noun masculine Kt = II. קַו Qr; absolute ( קֶ֫וֶה or קָוֶה ) Zech 1:16 ; construct ( קֶ֫וֶה or קְוֵה ) 1Kin 7:23 ; Jer 31:39 .
